text: いあいぎりの　めいじんが　ふねに　のってるって　いう　からよ　あって　みたら　これが　ただの　ふなよい　おやじ！

structure.jp: いあいぎりの　めいじんが　ふねに　のってるって　いう　からよ
structure.en: because they said a master of Cut was aboard the ship,
when I went and met him,

structure.jp: これが　ただの　ふなよい　おやじ！
structure.en: he was just a seasick old man!

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: のってるって　いう
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which comes right after what someone says. のってるって いう = 'they say he's aboard'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て form means trying something out; the たら ending adds 'when I did'. あって みたら = 'when I tried meeting him'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a verb gives the reason for what comes next. いう からよ = 'because they said so, see'.
